candidates.title: Aachu The Heart Landlady
candidates.suggested_slide_arc: One self-contained illustration: Aachu asks, Zuv reacts, the heart-rent joke lands instantly.
candidates.suggested_slide_1_moment: Aachu holds a small open wallet or rent note toward Zuv, standing beside a soft heart-shaped wall nook or cushion motif.
candidates.suggested_payoff_moment: Zuv points to his chest or sheepishly offers a tiny paper heart as payment.
candidates.visual_potential: Strong because the text, wallet/rent note, and heart motif all prove the line.

candidates.title: Receipt At The Door
candidates.suggested_slide_arc: Aachu stands at a tiny imaginary heart-shaped doorway handing Zuv a rent receipt.
candidates.suggested_slide_1_moment: Zuv steps through a heart-shaped doorway.
candidates.suggested_payoff_moment: Aachu stamps the receipt with a tiny heart.
candidates.visual_potential: Charming but more surreal and slightly less identity-safe.

visual_risks: Do not make Aachu look stern or caricatured.
Do not make the wallet too large or similar to the puppy image; use it as a gentle nod only.

slide_count_hints.reason: The text is a one-beat joke. More slides would dilute the payoff.
